# Welcome! {-}

Welcome to the Physics of Microbial Ecosystems (PoME) group! This handbook is intended as your complete guide to life in your new position. If you find it is __not__ a complete guide, please email Oli at o.meacock@sheffield.ac.uk with suggestions for additions.

Assuming you have access to the School of Biosciences' intranet, a lot of useful information can be found [here](https://sites.google.com/sheffield.ac.uk/biosciences-intranet/home). If you've not made it that far, check Section \@ref(IT) first.

You may also find what you are looking for on the [group website](https://sites.google.com/sheffield.ac.uk/microbial-ecosystem-physics/home).
